items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: I get this from Edward H. Morris, Melrose Music Corporation, see?

ctx.x: How silly I sound. It sounds alright, I'm sure. We'll play a little after a while. Let's see, we'll go ahead and look at the scrapbook. This is the one with the blossom seal that we just finished looking at. And it talks about her ragtime act here. That was in Baltimore. A newspaper. I'll just see what the other thing was.
I get this from Edward H. Morris, Melrose Music Corporation, see?
Oh yeah, that's...so they own it now. Let's see, this...Graham must have sold out. Yeah. Must have sold out his rights.
